item.title: When agents write most of the code, the job is evidence
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. How many agents one person can run is set by whether that person can confirm the work without reading every diff. What follows is the version I ran, and what each kind of evidence can be fooled by. Two minutes fifteen, English voice, captions burned into the picture with no toggle.
